snippet.title: Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge – Trailer | Medieval puzzle game, on Steam December 3
snippet.description:
Forgotten knowledge sleeps in five mystical realms. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows.

Mystical II: Forgotten Knowledge is a medieval puzzle game: 5 realms, 50 stages, 72 families and 216 painted objects. Bombs, gear walls, gems hidden in stones, keys and chests, and a gold trophy to win on every stage.

On Steam on December 3, 2026. Add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5464010/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=lancement

Follow Forgeur Games on Steam to hear about every new game:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/forgeurgames
